question: ToG/ToG-R 的搜索宽度和深度怎样联系到 LLM 调用次数？再与 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度、扩展预算对照，说明为什么这些公式/上限不能直接换算成统一运行时排名。
answer: ToG 的实验把搜索深度 Dmax 与 beam 宽度 N 作为性能探索变量，并指出计算成本随深度线性增加，因此默认把深度和宽度都设为3；该文还报告在深度超过3后性能增益递减。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644] ToG-R 的调用次数有明示上限：原文称 ToG-R 最多需要 ND + D + 1 次 LLM 调用，并说明 ToG-R 相比 ToG 取消了用 LLM 剪枝实体的步骤，从而降低总体成本与推理时间。[chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4] 不过，所给证据没有给出 ToG 本身的显式调用次数公式，也没有把宽度 N 和深度 D 逐项映射到 LLM 调用次数，因此 ToG 的宽度—深度—调用次数关系流程证据不足。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644][chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4] 关于 Tree-of-Traversals，所给证据只说明它是使用树搜索的零样本算法、可借助任意数量 KG 增强任意强 LLM，并在结论中强调零示例、无 schema 依赖和无训练；证据中没有给出其深度、扩展预算或调用次数上限的公式。[chunk_ac2dd6acd17189360638268b42945e7b][chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86] 因此，无法依据这些原文把 ToG/ToG-R 的 N、D 与 Tree-of-Traversals 的深度、扩展预算换算成统一运行时排名；这一比较缺少双方可对照的调用次数与预算定义，属于证据缺口，不能据此判定谁运行时更优。[chunk_8b9e861ea949a3eb2fc9ed5a97b24644][chunk_aa272a627cf75d5bf907fe3a860356c4][chunk_ac2dd6acd17189360638268b42945e7b][chunk_4b9f25dbcd34cf81a689e230345e1d86]

Do search depth and width matter for ToG?
To ex-
plore the influence of the search depth Dmax and the beam
width N on ToG’s performance, we conduct experiments
under settings with depths ranging from 1 to 4 and widths
from 1 to 4. As shown in Figure 3, ToG’s performance im-
proves with the search depth and width. This also implies
that ToG’s performance could potentially be improved
with the increment of the exploration depth and breadth.
However, considering the computational cost (which in-
creases linearly with the depth), we set both the depth
and width to 3 as the default experimental setting. On
the other hand, the performance growth diminishes when
the depth exceeds 3. This is mainly because only a small
part of questions have the reasoning depths (based on the
number of relations in SPARQL, as seen in Figure 12 in
the Appendix) of greater than 3.
Do different KGs affect ToG’s performance?
One of the main advantages of ToG is its plug-and-
play capabilities. As shown in Table 3, ToG achieves significant improvements with different source
KGs on CWQ and WebQSP, compared to CoT. On the other hand, different source KGs might have

evidence.source_relative_path: Methods/018_Tree-of-Traversals A Zero-Shot Reasoning Algorithm for Augmenting Black-box Language Model.pdf
evidence.quote:
Conclusion
Tree-of-Traversals is a powerful algorithm that en-
ables LLMs to utilize KG reasoning with zero
examples, no schema dependency, and no train-
ing. We demonstrate its efficacy experimentally
on multiple LLMs and datasets. We hope Tree-of-
Traversals continues to be developed and see value
in studying integration with personalized user KGs
as well as with other domain-specific datasets.

n=1 might have little impact on the following relation
exploration. Thus, we use the random beam search instead of the LLM-constrained beam search in
ToG for entity prune, referred to as random prune. Algorithm 1 and 2 show the implementation
details of the ToG and ToG-R. ToG-R needs at most ND + D + 1 calls to the LLM.
Compared to ToG, ToG-R offers two key benefits: 1) It eliminates the need for the process of pruning
entities using the LLM, thereby reducing the overall cost and reasoning time. 2) ToG-R primarily
emphasizes the literal information of relations, mitigating the risk of misguided reasoning when the
literal information of intermediate entities is missing or unfamiliar to the LLM.
